subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined idiom in the following sentence.

Buying a home in the city centre will cost you __an arm and a leg.__
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"cost you an arm and a leg"** means a very large amount of money; something that is very expensive. (बहुत महंगा)

 
 
• **Example:** The repairs on my car cost me an arm and a leg.
 
 
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Nothing extra** (कुछ भी अतिरिक्त नहीं): No additional cost or effort.

 
 
• **Example:** The service comes with nothing extra to pay.
 
 
 
• **A small amount of money** (थोड़ी राशि): A minimal sum of money.
 
 
• **Example:** I bought the book for a small amount of money.
 
 
 
• **Physical pain** (शारीरिक दर्द): Discomfort or suffering in the body.
 
 
• **Example:** He felt physical pain after the accident.
 
 

 

31:Ta40,

The correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. Philant
